name: Apache Corporation Tree Grant Program
summary: In-kind donations of trees to US nonprofits and government agencies for reforestation, habitat restoration and public greenspace planting; the funder gives trees, not cash.

status.quote: U.S. Tree Grant Program Applications for the 2026-2027 Apache Tree Grant Program are now closed.
U.K. Tree Grant Programme Applications for the 2025-2026 Apache Tree Grant Programme in the U.K. are now closed.

applicant_types.quote: provided more than 5 million trees to over 1,000 nonprofit charitable partners and government agencies in the U.S.

access.quote: U.S. Tree Grant Program Applications for the 2026-2027 Apache Tree Grant Program are now closed.

geography.quote: In 2023, we expanded the program to Scotland partnering with nonprofit organizations and government agencies. In 2025, we donated more than 16,000 trees to 14 U.S. nonprofit partner organizations. Since expanding internationally in 2023, the program has also supported conservation projects in the United Kingdom.
